messages:
mona: Quick heads-up: PR 4677 is failing docs CI. The optimize toolkit examples reference old quant names and use `batch_size`. Customer migration blocked.
rahul: I'll take it. Which files?
mona: optimize/quant-profiles.md, optimize/examples/python_batching.md, and optimize/migration-guide.md. Also an embed example links to /docs/old/kv_cache.md which 404s.
dez: I reprod locally. Old params: `quant: q4_0`, `batch_size: 1`. New runtime expects `q_standard_q4_1` and batching uses `window_ms` + `max_inflight`. Also recommend showing `cache.kv_ttl_secs`.
rahul: Proposed Python example update:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="...")
resp = client.generate(
  model="redwood/fast-13b-q_standard_q4_1",
  input="Summarize the design in one paragraph",
  optimize={"batching": {"window_ms": 40, "max_inflight": 6},"cache": {"kv_ttl_secs": 300, "prefix_kv": true},"quant_profile": "q_standard_q4_1"}
)
print(resp.text)
```
ci-bot: [automated] Linkcheck: 1 broken link in PR 4677 -> optimize/embedding.md line 22.
raz: I'll add a redirect and a brief migration blurb: "q4_0 -> q4_1: expect lower memory, minor logits differences; run quick eval and fallback to fp16 if needed."
mona: Please also pin snippet CI to runtime image `redwood/runtime:2026-02` for verification.
dez: Added short YAML example for quant-profiles.md and a brief note about per-channel quantization. Ran mkdocs locally  tests OK.
rahul: Pushed branch docs/4677-quant-batch-fixes, CI rerun in progress.
ci-bot: Build: success. Linkcheck: success.
support-bot: Notified support: "docs updated for q4_1 and batching examples; migration snippet available at /optimize/migration-guide.md"
mona: Great work, merging after CI green. I'll follow up with release notes and ping the customer.
